show.title: How to Pray for the Sick and Expect a Miracle
show.subtitle: The podcast of the book by Graham Marsland
show.voices: Two voices made with artificial intelligence talk through one part of the book in each episode. Everything they say comes from the book and from the Bible.

episodes.title: Can I Really Pray for the Sick?
episodes.story: A prayer in a car outside a train station
episodes.description: A prayer Graham prayed for a friend in a car outside a train station, and the one sentence under the whole book: find what God has said in His Word, ask Him to do what He said, and expect Him to do it.

episodes.title: Is God Willing to Heal?
episodes.description: A man with leprosy knelt before Jesus and asked whether He was willing. Jesus reached out His hand, touched him and said, “I am willing.”
episodes.picture: An outstretched hand (Jesus reached out His hand)

episodes.title: What Is God’s Name?
episodes.description: At Marah the water was too bitter to drink. There God told His people one of His names: “I am the LORD who heals you.”
episodes.picture: The piece of wood and the water at Marah

episodes.title: What Did Jesus Pay For?
episodes.story: The man lowered through the roof
episodes.description: Friends lowered a paralysed man through a roof to reach Jesus. This episode is about what Jesus carried to the cross, and why He said, “It is finished.”

episodes.title: Is This Only for the Gifted Few?
episodes.description: Ananias was a disciple in Damascus when God sent him to lay his hands on Saul. This episode is about who may pray for the sick.

episodes.title: What Do I Do When the Symptoms Shout?
episodes.description: A Roman centurion told Jesus, “just say the word.” This episode is about holding on to what God has said when the symptoms say something else.
episodes.picture: An open Bible (He sent His word)

episodes.title: Why Does God Want Me to Ask?
episodes.description: Blind Bartimaeus called out from the roadside, and Jesus asked him, “What do you want Me to do for you?”

episodes.title: Am I Begging, or Am I His Child?
episodes.description: King Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed. This episode is about asking the way a child asks a father, not the way a beggar asks a stranger.
episodes.picture: Bread and a fish (a father’s good gifts)

episodes.title: What Am I Expecting?
episodes.story: The lame man at the Beautiful Gate
episodes.description: A man who had never walked sat at the temple gate called Beautiful. Peter said to him, “Look at us!” This episode is about expecting.

episodes.title: What Was She Saying to Herself?
episodes.story: The woman who touched His cloak
episodes.description: A woman who had been ill for twelve years pressed through the crowd to touch the cloak of Jesus. This episode is about what she kept saying to herself.

episodes.title: What If I Have Doubts?
episodes.description: A father brought his son to Jesus and cried out, “I do believe; help my unbelief!” This episode is for anyone who believes and doubts at the same time.
episodes.picture: A small flame (“I do believe; help my unbelief!”)

episodes.title: A Wave or a Rock?
episodes.description: Peter stepped out of the boat and walked on the water towards Jesus, and then he saw the wind. This episode is about doubt, and what to do with it.

episodes.title: What If I Look Foolish?
episodes.chapterTitle: Do Not Let Me Be Put to Shame
episodes.description: On Mount Carmel, Elijah prayed in front of everyone and waited for God to answer. This episode is about praying aloud when you are afraid of looking foolish.
episodes.picture: The altar and the fire on Carmel

episodes.title: Whose Name Is on the Line?
episodes.chapterTitle: Do Not Let Me Be Put to Shame
episodes.description: At the tomb of Lazarus, Jesus thanked the Father aloud before anyone had seen an answer. This episode is about whose name is on the line when you pray.

episodes.title: What Does “In the Name of Jesus” Mean?
episodes.chapterTitle: In the Name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth
episodes.description: Peter said to a man named Aeneas, “Jesus Christ heals you!” This episode is about what it means to pray in the name of Jesus.
episodes.picture: A crown (the name above every name)

episodes.title: Do I Ask, or Do I Command?
episodes.chapterTitle: In the Name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth
episodes.description: Peter knelt and prayed, then turned and said, “Tabitha, get up!” This episode is about asking the Father first, and then speaking in the name of Jesus.

episodes.title: Why Did Jesus Heal?
episodes.description: Nobody asked Jesus for anything at the gate of Nain. He saw a widow, and He had compassion on her.

episodes.title: How Should a Sick Person Be Treated?
episodes.story: The blind man led by the hand
episodes.description: Jesus took a blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. This episode is about treating the person who is sick with honour.
episodes.picture: One person leading another by the hand

episodes.title: How Do I Actually Pray for Someone?
episodes.chapterTitle: How to Pray for the Sick
episodes.story: A prayer for a friend, step by step
episodes.description: A simple way to pray for someone who is sick, one step at a time, from asking their permission to speaking in the name of Jesus.

episodes.title: What Do I Do After I Pray?
episodes.chapterTitle: How to Pray for the Sick
episodes.description: Ten men with leprosy went on their way as Jesus told them, and one came back to give thanks. This episode is about what to do after you have prayed.
episodes.picture: Ten, and the one who came back

episodes.title: Does This Still Happen Today?
episodes.description: Graham tells what happened when he prayed for a young woman in Perth, as the book tells it.

episodes.title: What If I Am Still Sick?
episodes.chapterTitle: When You Do Not See It Yet
episodes.description: For anyone who has prayed and is still sick. A mother who would not stop asking Jesus for her daughter, and why a person who is still sick is never to blame.

episodes.title: How Long Do I Keep Asking?
episodes.chapterTitle: When You Do Not See It Yet
episodes.description: Elijah prayed for rain and sent his servant to look towards the sea seven times. This episode is about how long to keep asking.
episodes.picture: A small cloud rising from the sea, and seven marks

episodes.title: Where Do I Start?
episodes.description: Jesus sent seventy-two of His followers out two by two. This episode is about where to begin.
episodes.picture: A road, and two people setting out
